name: internal_source_nonhybrid
header:
theorem internal_source_nonhybrid (hg : N.graph.GalledDetour) (e : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    ¬N.graph.IsHybrid (N.graph.source e.val)

name: inner_skeleton_iff
header:
theorem inner_skeleton_iff (v : N.OriginalBlobVertex b) :
    M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (Sum.inl v) ↔ ¬N.graph.IsHybrid v.val

name: coreEdgeLift_source
header:
theorem coreEdgeLift_source (e : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    OG.source (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb e)=coreLift N b hg hb ((coreGraph N b hg).source e)

name: coreEdgeLift_target
header:
theorem coreEdgeLift_target (e : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    OG.target (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb e)=coreLift N b hg hb ((coreGraph N b hg).target e)

name: coreEdgeLift_original
header:
theorem coreEdgeLift_original (e : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    M.openedOriginalEdge (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb e)=Sum.inl e

name: coreEdgeLift_injective
header: theorem coreEdgeLift_injective : Function.Injective (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb)

name: core_cut_walk_lifts
retained_port_inner_nonhybrid
header:
theorem retained_port_inner_nonhybrid (p : N.BlobPort b)
    (hv : M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (Sum.inr (Sum.inl p))) :
    ¬N.graph.IsHybrid (N.originalPortInner b p).val

name: collapse_coreLift
header:
theorem collapse_coreLift (v : CoreVertex N b) :
    collapse N b hg hb (coreLift N b hg hb v)=v

name: core_edge_collapsed_source
header:
theorem core_edge_collapsed_source (e : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    collapse N b hg hb (OG.source (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb e))=(coreGraph N b hg).source e

name: core_edge_collapsed_target
header:
theorem core_edge_collapsed_target (e : N.OriginalBlobArc b) :
    collapse N b hg hb (OG.target (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb e))=(coreGraph N b hg).target e

name: opened_original_injective
header: theorem opened_original_injective : Function.Injective M.openedOriginalEdge

name: occurrenceRaw_original
header:
theorem occurrenceRaw_original (e : M.HybridParentOccurrence) :
    Sum.inl (occurrenceRaw N b hb e).val=e.val

name: opened_edge_core_or_constant
header:
theorem opened_edge_core_or_constant (f : M.OpenedHybridEdge) :
    (∃ e : N.OriginalBlobArc b, f=coreEdgeLift N b hg hb e) ∨
      collapse N b hg hb (OG.source f)=collapse N b hg hb (OG.target f)

name: opened_cut_walk_collapses
openedOutEdge_target_skeleton
header:
theorem openedOutEdge_target_skeleton (e : N.RootedCapArc b)
    (hs : M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (M.graph.source e))
    (ht : M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (M.graph.target e)) :
    OG.target (M.openedOutEdge e hs)=Sum.inl ⟨M.graph.target e,ht⟩

name: discarded_edge_step
header:
theorem discarded_edge_step (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) (e : N.RootedCapArc b)
    (hne : ∀ a : N.OriginalBlobArc b, e≠Sum.inl a)
    (hs : M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (M.graph.source e))
    (ht : M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (M.graph.target e)) :
    OG.ReachWithout (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k)
      (Sum.inl ⟨M.graph.source e,hs⟩) (Sum.inl ⟨M.graph.target e,ht⟩)

name: fresh_root_fibre_walk
header:
theorem fresh_root_fibre_walk (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) (r : N.RootedCapRootTag b)
    (hv : M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (Sum.inr (Sum.inr r))) :
    OG.ReachWithout (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k)
      (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr r),hv⟩)
      (coreLift N b hg hb (Sum.inl ⟨N.originalRootedCapEntry b,
        N.originalRootedCapEntry_nonroot_not_hybrid b r.property⟩))

name: port_fibre_walk
header:
theorem port_fibre_walk (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) (p : N.BlobPort b)
    (hv : M.SkeletonVertexPredicate (Sum.inr (Sum.inl p))) :
    OG.ReachWithout (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k)
      (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inl p),hv⟩)
      (coreLift N b hg hb (Sum.inl ⟨N.originalPortInner b p,
        retained_port_inner_nonhybrid N b hb p hv⟩))

name: collapse_fibre_walk
header:
theorem collapse_fibre_walk (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) (v : M.OpenedHybridVertex) :
    OG.ReachWithout (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k) v
      (coreLift N b hg hb (collapse N b hg hb v))

name: actual_opened_core_cut_iff
header:
theorem actual_opened_core_cut_iff (k : N.OriginalBlobArc b) (a c : M.OpenedHybridVertex) :
    OG.ReachWithout (coreEdgeLift N b hg hb k) a c ↔
      (coreGraph N b hg).ReachWithout k (collapse N b hg hb a) (collapse N b hg hb c)
